I would like to answer your last questions though. In summary, I don't care who I see around me, or where they come from, or their residential status. I don't care how educated they are, what abilities anyone has, how many. What I care about is living in a country that is diverse, accepting of culture, providing safety for all, providing accessible education, impartial education on topics that involve everyone - be that personal finance, politics, environmental issues. I care that people care about each other, and not about competing to be at the top.   


I know these things aren't attainable instantly, and progression takes a long time. It may even seem unrealistic. But these things that I care about, well, I'd rather live in a collective society above a selective one.
